author: mmusich
body:
Adds a per-menu timing comparison (current PR vs. reference IB) to the HLT Phase-2 timing Jenkins job, alongside the existing memory comparisons.

- Uses circles' `compare_multiple_json_hist.py` on the `FastTimerService` JSON outputs already produced by `runHLTTiming.sh` (`${RES_PREFIX}.json`, `_OnCPU.json`, `_NGT.json`).
- Reuses the baseline fetch already done for the memory CSVs (`get_jenkins_artifacts hlt-p2-timing/${COMPARISON_RELEASE}/...`), since the baseline JSONs sit in the same location.
- Produces three plots  HLT (GPU), HLT (CPU), NGT Scouting, saved directly to the job's upload directory and shown in a new section on the summary `index.html`.
- Falls back to a PR-only plot when no passing baseline is found, same as the existing `run_compare()` logic for memory.

No changes to `runHLTTiming.sh`, it already produces the required JSON files.
title: Add PR-vs-baseline timing breakdown plots to HLT Phase-2 timing job
